lines: Three, two, one, rise onto tiptoes
I want to fly to a bright tomorrow, planner
I want to jump more with you
A relaxed, steady beat feels a little cramped
I wonder if it’s fine to remain as I am
I want to connect, I still want to reach
But if we go far, it’s a little low
I want to be gently at the start of hope
If I load pure white feelings
Planner gazing over the blue scenery
Ready, jump, float in the air
I want to fly more with you, planner
My heart feels fluffy, I yearn for tomorrow
I want to expand, but I won’t leave
If the wall I climb alone is a bit high
Step and step, looking up ahead
I’ll surely be at the distance where we hold hands
When I turn, my steps won’t stop
This place will become yesterday too
Planner gazing over the blue scenery
Ready, jump, float in the air
I want to fly more with you, planner
My heart feels fluffy, I yearn for tomorrow
